headline: Millersville score a dozen before conference play opens
dek: Millersville have scored twelve and conceded three, and both of the season's box-score gaps are theirs: the site holds those scores and not the shape of them. Slippery Rock and West Chester have yet to score, and every programme now has a match on the record.
displaced_by: Pitt-Johnstown played and won at Chestnut Hill, so the dek's 'yet to play' clause no longer held; the headline's story stands

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The conference's goals are stacked at one end: Millersville have outscored Bloomsburg and Seton Hill together, while at the other end Slippery Rock and West Chester have no goal to draw.

wire.line: Slippery Rock and West Chester are the only sides yet to score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Shepherd's visit to District of Columbia is the one date on the record that has passed with no result, and it is Shepherd's alone; no final is missing its score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Pitt-Johnstown's first match on the record was a win at Chestnut Hill: four goals scored and two conceded, the four coming from four different scorers.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: California (Pa.) have conceded ten goals, more than any other programme has let in, and scored five.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Bloomsburg's seven goals have come from six different scorers.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Shepherd are unbeaten, with Aidan Houck making fifteen saves and conceding twice across their matches.

last_match.line: Pitt-Johnstown open their record with a win, the last of the conference's sides to play.

next_match.line: Ashland have already won at Millersville; this is Gannon's first match away from home.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
